about: The goal shown on screen, top left. The first goal whose done_flag is not set (and whose requires_flag is set, if any) is shown. map + target make an arrow point the way: target is an NPC role, or a node name in that map (e.g. FarmhouseDoor). Flags come from dialogue (Quest_Flag / Effect) or from the game: first_crop_planted, first_sleep.

objectives.text: Visit the village east of your farm and meet the village chief
Meet Marcus at the village shop
Plant your first crop: hoe (1), seeds (3), then water (2)
Go to sleep at your farmhouse door to end the day
Talk to the visitor at your farmhouse
Earn {buyback_price} g to buy back your land before the deadline
